instruction: Ensure Thunderbird is the sole application left in your favorites dock by removing the rest.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires removing vim.desktop and google-chrome.desktop from the favorites dock, leaving only thunderbird.desktop. Initial setup creates favorites list ['thunderbird.desktop', 'vim.desktop', 'google-chrome.desktop']. After removing the other two apps, the expected result is ['thunderbird.desktop']. Uses existing check_gnome_favorite_apps metric which compares sets (order-independent).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts GNOME favorites list using gsettings command - captures the right state for verification
Metric function correctly handles type='rule' parameter passing - accesses expected['expected'] directly from rules dict
Complete coverage of instruction requirements - verifies that only Thunderbird remains in favorites (removes all others)
Correct comparison logic using set equality - appropriately handles order-independence of favorites list
Expected value ['thunderbird.desktop'] is semantically correct for the instruction requirement
Data flow is correct: getter extracts favorites → metric parses and compares → returns 1 if only Thunderbird present, 0 otherwise
Edge cases handled: length mismatch returns 0, set comparison handles different orderings
